description:
Create the `/api/v1/graph?lens=topology|flow|operations` endpoint that serves lens-specific node/edge projections. Build on the existing overview endpoint and depgraph package.

This work should:
- add capture nodes and classified_as edges (Capture → BacklogItem via classification.items)
- add execution records with executes edges (ExecutionRecord → BacklogItem) and follow_up edges (ExecutionRecord → ExecutionRecord via parent_execution_id)
- add scenario nodes with targets edges resolved from acceptance_allow globs
- add agent-run nodes with spawned_run edges (ExecutionRecord → Run via run_id)
- return data in React Flow-compatible format (nodes array with type/position, edges array with source/target/type)
- implement server-side filtering by lens and default status exclusions per lens
- add SSE endpoint (`GET /api/v1/graph/stream?lens=operations`) for real-time push updates on the Operations lens — dispatching events on scenario status changes, execution state transitions, and agent run updates
- implement server-side event dispatch infrastructure for SSE

Canonical node types: Capture, BacklogItem, Initiative, Scenario, ExecutionRecord, Run
Canonical edge types: depends_on, member_of, classified_as, executes, targets, follow_up, spawned_run

This is the foundation item that makes the rest of the redesign possible. Keep it greenfield and type-safe.
